access_token.description: Workday REST API bearer access token. Never log or commit this value.

base_url.description: Workday tenant hostname/base URL for REST services, for example https://wd2-impl-services1.workday.com.

tenant.description: Legacy Workday tenant label retained for compatibility with existing saved configs; official 2026.30 service paths use base_url plus service path.
